decls.name: SublemmaNormProduct

paper_span.quote: because the algebraic norm of a nonzero algebraic integer is a nonzero integer.

decls.rationale: The norm inequality driving Lemma 2.6: for \(0 \ne \beta \in \mathcal{O}_K\), \(\prod_r |\sigma_r(D^{-1}\beta)| = D^{-f}|N_{K/\mathbb{Q}}(\beta)|^{1/2} \ge D^{-f}\), because the norm of a nonzero algebraic integer is a nonzero integer.
